summary: Create the active SESSION_SCOPE.md as combined scoped authority, either from single-session evidence or by adopting and narrowing delivery/phase authority.

triggers: single-session safety evidence required when delivery governance is not used
single-session work needs affirmative safety evidence
a durable delivery scope must be narrowed into this session
a durable phase is adopted into the active session
validation/review-only work needs explicit session authority

requires_artifacts: _hirmos/system/delivery/DELIVERY_PLAN.md when Delivery Shape Decision selects a durable delivery shape
_hirmos/system/delivery/<delivery-id>/DELIVERY_SCOPE.md when Delivery Shape Decision selects a durable delivery shape
_hirmos/system/delivery/<delivery-id>/phases/PHASE-xx.md when Delivery Shape Decision selects MULTI_SESSION_DELIVERY_WITH_PHASE_FILES
